create_adsorbate_from_atoms: create an Adsorbate object from an ase.Atoms structure with specified binding atom indices
create_adsorbate_from_smiles: create an Adsorbate object by looking up a SMILES string in the adsorbate database
create_adsorbate_from_db_id: create an Adsorbate object by selecting one from the database using its integer index
create_adsorbate_random: create an Adsorbate object by randomly sampling from the adsorbate database pickle file
rotate_adsorbate: rotate an adsorbate atoms object randomly or with heuristic cone placement around a binding atom
